about: Which pages use which program the tool kit lists (programs status), so a page says when one it uses is missing (0.87.0, docs/design-record.md, Setup). Keys are the kit's program keys; values are page names (src/lib/navigation/place.ts). git has its own line on every page, so it is not here. A game's own program is listed by its key and shows only on that game's pages. A new program the kit lists joins here when a page uses it.
